TaleWorlds was co-founded by İpek Yavuz and Armağan Yavuz in 2005 in Ankara, Türkiye. During the development phase of the first Mount & Blade, İpek Yavuz was heavily involved in visual design. Today, TaleWorlds has amassed a global following with the Mount & Blade series.

Kale was infested with pests a while ago. The cabbage caterpillars first ate the leaves into poles before being killed by imidacloprid, and then ate the poles into mounds. Fortunately, for some unknown biological reasons, they are only obsessed with these two rows of eggplants, which are twenty centimeters apart. They are good-looking and have no bug holes. There is a red maple outside the vegetable garden. It is nothing special, but there is a cucumber hanging on it. The cucumber climbed up on its own. It passed first the wooden frame, then the holly bush, and finally reached the fork of red maple branches. There is only one plant, with fan-shaped leaves and curly vines mixed in with the maple leaves, red and green crowded together. After a few days, a white cucumber appeared on it. ja.summary: 「この推理が事件の真実であることを確認し、公表しますか？」このプロンプトに直面して、私は躊躇しました。 1時間以上の捜査、尋問、証拠収集を経て、私は手元にある手がかりに基づいて事件の容疑者を推理しました。しかし、まだ完全に解決されていないいくつかの疑問があり、私の結論が「真実」であるかどうかは少し自信がありません。エンディング分岐のあるミッションです。プレイヤーが間違いを犯すと、事件が終わるまで「戻って」再度推理することしかできません。したがって、ゲームが私に次の選択の「結果」に耐えるよう促したとき、その瞬間、私はタスクの指示に従ってマウスをクリックし続ける視聴者ではなく、本当に探偵になったように思えました。この種の体験は、これまでの 2D ゲームでは見つけることが困難です。真実は一つしかない！本日、Le Elements開発の新作ゲーム『City of Silver』が正式に「二項対立テスト」を開始しました。先ほどお話ししたのは、第2期ベータ版の新たな怪事件捜査支部「死体蘇」です。

en.title: A newspaper, a strange case, how "City of Silver" allows players to become detectives
en.summary: "Do you want to confirm that this inference is the truth of the case and make it public?" Faced with this prompt, I hesitated. After more than an hour of investigation, questioning and evidence collection, I have deduced the suspect in the case based on the clues in my hand. However, there are still several doubts that have not been fully resolved, which makes me a little unsure whether my conclusion is the "truth". This is a mission with a branching ending. Once the player makes a mistake, they can only "go back" and deduce it again until the case is over. So, when the game prompted me to bear the "consequences" of my next choices, at that moment I seemed to have really become a detective, rather than a viewer who kept clicking the mouse according to the task prompts. This kind of experience is difficult to find in previous two-dimensional games. There is only one truth! Today, the new game "City of Silver" developed by Le Elements officially started its "dichotomy test". What I just mentioned is the new strange case investigation branch "Dead Body Su" in the second beta.

"Offline Translator" uses the translation model of Firefox's local translation function, and once you download the language pack that includes the translation model, it is an application that allows you to translate even when you are completely offline. read more...
